main_text.p: وثبتت هذه الفرق الاربعة علي انما الفرقتين الملكية والمارونية اللتان ذكوناهما فرقة واحدة ورايهما في الاتحاد والاقنوم واي واحد

Constat itaq; has sectas esse quatuor, quoniam illæ duæ sectæ nimirum Melchitarum, & Maronitarum, quas memoravimus, sunt una eademq; secta, eorumq; opinio circa unionem & personam una eademque est, fusius hac de re scribit in Epistola ad Arsenium Episcopum Haincurensem sub An Alexandri 1370, qui est Christi Domini 1053. Schismatis ac tantorum malorum, quæ inde sequuta sunt; quæqve hactenus tanto nostro damno experimur, Justiniani fuit petulantia, seu potius ignavia, & inertia quemadmodum ex Græcis literis consignârunt Theophanes, Zonaras, Cedrenus, & alii: quandoquidem Maronitæ nostri Libani incolæ, quos laudati mox Græci auctores ap-pel-pellitan[?] [illegible, ~2 letters] qv Arabun[?] rio ita Arabiæ tos fe eff niano pe tionibus rent Ror M equu[?] Mardait fiones, & Gedreni no audi inquit, a Arabum nitque ut in Libar ret, eoqu rent in f[?] ferv[?]um. ad Abim gratia i[?] hensam[?]

page.notes: The Arabic lines are copied from the scan; words marked by none are read with some doubt in the first line (وثبتت, هذه, الفرق) and should be checked against the original. The first Latin word "Constat" and the word "fusius" are clear. The Arabic is set as one stanza. The first line is cut off at the left edge, so the word is not known. The Arabic-looking character before "qv" is not legible and is left as illegible. Several word endings are cut off at the edge and are marked [?]. Italic text runs from "nitque ut" to the end. The reading "eoqu" and the ending of "Mardait" are uncertain because of the cut.
